![](images/a0/a09aa5c81ec7775f390901569afb0468204c49752eb401845e6836317616f25d.png)

Find $\frac{dy}{dx}$ for the circle shown above.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The diagram gives center $(1,-1)$ and radius $3$, so $(x-1)^2+(y+1)^2=9$. Differentiating gives $2(x-1)+2(y+1)y'=0$. Therefore $$\frac{dy}{dx}=-\frac{x-1}{y+1}$$ for $y\ne-1$.
